book.name: EFESIOS
book.title: U Uꞌ ITZꞌIBꞌA BꞌEN U PABLOXEꞌ QꞌU NIMAN TETZ U JESUUSTU EEFESO U uꞌuj uvaꞌ itzꞌibꞌa bꞌen u Pablo te unqꞌa aa Éfeso uvaꞌ ni niman u Jesús

content: Niyolon u Pablo tiꞌ unqꞌa bꞌaꞌneꞌ uvaꞌ la ibꞌan unqꞌa niman tetz u Jesús
As la val sete, ech koj chit la ebꞌaneꞌ echeꞌ uveꞌ nibꞌan u Tiixheꞌ, tan ex meꞌal ikꞌaol Aak. As xoꞌn ex te Aak.

As xoꞌnoj chit veꞌt etibꞌ sevatzaj, echeꞌ uvaꞌ kat ibꞌan u Jesucristo sqiꞌ, tan kat taqꞌ tibꞌ Aak kamoj sqiꞌ echeꞌ umaj oy uvaꞌ ni toksal vatz u Tiixheꞌ as echeꞌ isibꞌil umaj txoo uvaꞌ nitzꞌeꞌsal jeꞌ vatz Aak uvaꞌ vaꞌl chit itxꞌumtxꞌul toon vatz Aak.

Pet jankꞌal ex uvaꞌ ex itenam Tiixh, as yeꞌ la uchi uvaꞌ la eyansa etibꞌ tukꞌ umaj uxhchil. As yeꞌ la ebꞌan unqꞌa veeꞌ uvaꞌ chꞌixubꞌal chittuꞌ. As yeꞌ la etachva unqꞌa tetz vemooleꞌ. As mitaꞌn kuxh la eyolbꞌe unqꞌa vaꞌlexheꞌ uveꞌ nibꞌan unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ.
As mitaꞌn la uch etalat unqꞌa vaꞌlexhla yoleꞌ echeꞌ umaj yol uvaꞌ la teesa tibꞌ eqꞌii staꞌn, tan yeꞌl etokebꞌal stiꞌ. Pet aal la etaqꞌ taꞌntiixh te u Tiixheꞌ tiꞌ vibꞌaꞌnil Aakeꞌ uvaꞌ ni taqꞌ sete.

As ootzimal setaꞌn uvaꞌ abꞌil niyansa tibꞌ tukꞌ umaj uxhchil, moj nibꞌan unqꞌa veeꞌ uvaꞌ chꞌixubꞌal chittuꞌ. As echat unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ uvaꞌ ni tachva txꞌiibꞌal iqꞌii imool, tan aꞌ veꞌt u txꞌiibꞌal iqꞌiieꞌ ni toksa vaatzil itiixh, tan aꞌ ni toksakat taama tiꞌ u txꞌiibꞌal iqꞌiieꞌ. As aꞌ uxhchileꞌ uvaꞌ yeꞌl tokebꞌal xoꞌl u tenameꞌ uvaꞌ at jaqꞌ u tijleꞌm u Tiixheꞌ.

As etaqꞌak etibꞌ maxtibꞌeloj te unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ uvaꞌ yeꞌl kuxh itxaꞌk viyoleꞌ, tan tiꞌ unqꞌa vaꞌlexhla txumbꞌaleꞌ echeꞌ unqꞌa veeꞌ kat vallu sete, as aꞌ stiꞌeꞌ la ulkat vitxꞌiꞌtziꞌl u Tiixheꞌ tiꞌ unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ uvaꞌ aꞌ kuxh u paasan tziila txumbꞌaleꞌ nibꞌaneꞌ.
As yeꞌ la emolo etibꞌ tukꞌ unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ uvaꞌ vaꞌlexh kuxh vitxumbꞌaleꞌ nibꞌaneꞌ.

Pet aal la ebꞌan u bꞌaꞌneꞌ, tan ech vetxumbꞌaleꞌ echeꞌ umaj uxhchil uvaꞌ nixaan vatz u sajeꞌ. As kꞌuxh echik vetxumbꞌaleꞌ bꞌaxa echeꞌ umaj uxhchil uvaꞌ nixaan tu tokto, as cheel nexaan veꞌt vatz u sajeꞌ, tan at veꞌt ok ex kꞌatz u Kubꞌaal Jesucristo.
As jankꞌal oꞌ uvaꞌ ech u kutxumbꞌaleꞌ echeꞌ u uxhchileꞌ uvaꞌ nixaan vatz u sajeꞌ, as oꞌ sula aama la ibꞌaneꞌ, tan aꞌ u jikla txumbꞌaleꞌ la kubꞌaneꞌ.
Estiꞌeꞌ ni val sete, etitzꞌataj jeꞌ etibꞌ tiꞌ ebꞌanat unqꞌa veeꞌ uvaꞌ bꞌaꞌn vatz u Kubꞌaal Jesucristo.
As ebꞌanak unqꞌa veeꞌ uvaꞌ nibꞌan unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ uveꞌ ech vitxumbꞌaleꞌ echeꞌ u uxhchileꞌ uvaꞌ nixaan tu toktoeꞌ. Pet la etaloꞌk vipaav unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ ste, tan yeꞌ la txakon veꞌt stiꞌ uveꞌ nibꞌaneꞌ.
As chꞌixubꞌal chiteꞌ uvaꞌ la kuyolbꞌe unqꞌa vaꞌlexheꞌ uvaꞌ nijutxi unqꞌa paasan tziieꞌ ibꞌanataꞌ.
As jankꞌal unqꞌa veeꞌ nijutxi unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ ibꞌanataꞌ, as la chit el chꞌuꞌleꞌ vatz saj, tan aꞌ u sajeꞌ la kꞌuchun el tzan,
echeꞌ uvaꞌ ni tal umaꞌl u yol:

content.text: Oolsa aama, axh uvaꞌ vatik kuxh aama taꞌn u vaꞌlexheꞌ.
As elen chꞌuꞌl xoꞌl unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ uvaꞌ echeꞌ kamnaj vatz u Tiixheꞌ.
As la itxiju veꞌt u Cristo u aanxelaleꞌ, taqꞌ u yoleꞌ ni taleꞌ.

content: As la chit etoksa etaama tiꞌ etilat jeꞌ etibꞌ tiꞌ u bꞌaꞌneꞌ uvaꞌ nebꞌaneꞌ. As yeꞌ la ebꞌan u paasan tziilla txumbꞌaleꞌ. Pet atoj etxumbꞌal tiꞌ ebꞌanat uveꞌ bꞌaꞌn vatz u Tiixheꞌ.
As ebꞌantaj chit u bꞌaꞌneꞌ tul uvaꞌ nitel tuch sevatz, tan mamaꞌla vaꞌlexhla txumbꞌal nibꞌan unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ tu unqꞌa qꞌiieꞌ.
Yeꞌ kuxh ebꞌan umaj txumbꞌal taꞌn onkonil. Pet etoksataj etaama tiꞌ epal stuul uvaꞌ abꞌiste u bꞌaꞌneꞌ uvaꞌ nisaꞌ u Kubꞌaaleꞌ uvaꞌ la ebꞌaneꞌ.
As qꞌabꞌaniꞌk ex, tan la teesa ex u qꞌabꞌaꞌmeꞌ tu bꞌey. Pet atoj etxumbꞌal taꞌn u Tiixhla Espíritu tiꞌ ebꞌanat u bꞌaꞌneꞌ.
As iyakꞌinsataj tibꞌ etaama sevatzaj tukꞌ unqꞌa bꞌitzeꞌ tetz u Tiixheꞌ. As tukꞌ chit etaanxelal la ebꞌitza unqꞌa bꞌitzeꞌ uvaꞌ tu Salmo as tukꞌ kaꞌt unqꞌa bꞌitzeꞌ tiꞌ etoksat iqꞌii u Kubꞌaaleꞌ.
As yeꞌ la eyaꞌsa etaqꞌat taꞌntiixh te u Kubꞌaal Tiixheꞌ tukꞌ vibꞌii u Kubꞌaal Jesucristo, tiꞌ unqꞌa bꞌaꞌnileꞌ uveꞌ nibꞌan Aak sete.
Nichusun u Pablo tiꞌ uvaꞌ kam la tulbꞌe unqꞌa niman tetz u Jesús tatin tikabꞌal
As palojtaj ex stuul uvaꞌ kam enimat etibꞌ sevatzaj tiꞌ ekꞌuchataꞌ uvaꞌ ex niman tetz u Cristo.
As ex ixqela, ech enimat vetzumeleꞌ echeꞌ enimat u Kubꞌaal Jesucristo,

tan ech tatin u tzumelaeꞌ tiꞌ tilat isuuchil u tixqeleꞌ echeꞌ tatin u Jesucristoeꞌ tiꞌ tilat isuuchil vitenameꞌ, tan ech tatin Aakeꞌ sqiꞌ echeꞌ tatin u kuviꞌeꞌ tiꞌ u kuchiꞌoleꞌ. As Aakeꞌ u qꞌalpun qetzeꞌ, jankꞌal oꞌ uvaꞌ oꞌ veꞌt niman tetz Aak skukajayil.
As ech kunimat u Jesucristo tukꞌ qaanxelal, as echat la ebꞌaneꞌ, ex ixqela, tiꞌ enimat vetzumeleꞌ.
As ex tzumela, xoꞌnoj vetixqeleꞌ sete echeꞌ kat ibꞌan u Cristo sqe, oꞌ uvaꞌ oꞌ itenam Aak, tan kat taqꞌ tibꞌ Aak kamoj sqiꞌ,
tiꞌ toksat oꞌ Aak sitenam. As kat ijosqꞌi veꞌt Aak u qaanxelaleꞌ taꞌn viyoleꞌ,

aqꞌal uvaꞌ achvebꞌal veꞌt oꞌ vatz Aak la ibꞌaneꞌ tul la teqꞌo ok oꞌ Aak svatz, echeꞌ nibꞌan umaj ixoj tukꞌ vitzumeleꞌ tul ni teqꞌo tibꞌ tukꞌ tixqel, tan chꞌiꞌumal tilon ixoj. As yeꞌl tzꞌil at tiꞌ ixoj. As mitaꞌn u toksaꞌm ixojeꞌ mochꞌin tibꞌ, tan yeꞌl tzꞌil at stiꞌ. As ech oꞌeꞌ vatz Aak, tan josqꞌimal veꞌt u qaanxelaleꞌ taꞌn Aak.

As ech kat tulbꞌe oꞌ u Cristo tiꞌ ixoꞌnit oꞌ Aak, as echat la ebꞌaneꞌ, ex tzumela, tan la exoꞌni vetixqeleꞌ echeꞌ exoꞌnit vechiꞌoleꞌ. As abꞌil uvaꞌ nixoꞌni u tixqeleꞌ, as eela kuxh stukꞌ uvaꞌ nixoꞌni jeꞌ tibꞌ,
tan yeꞌl umaj uxhchil ati uvaꞌ ni tixva vichiꞌoleꞌ. Pet nixoꞌni vichiꞌoleꞌ. As nikꞌuula vichiꞌoleꞌ tiꞌ ixoꞌnitaꞌ. As ech nibꞌan u Cristo sqe, oꞌ uvaꞌ oꞌ itenam Aak,
as vatzul veꞌt qatin tukꞌ Aak, as ech bꞌan qaꞌneꞌ tukꞌ Aak echeꞌ bꞌanik taꞌn vibꞌajil Aakeꞌ tukꞌ vichiꞌoleꞌ tul uvaꞌ atik Aak vatz u txꞌavaꞌeꞌ.
Estiꞌeꞌ uvaꞌ tzꞌibꞌamal kan u yoleꞌ uvaꞌ ech ni tal ileꞌ:

content.text: La el chꞌuꞌl u najeꞌ kꞌatz vitxutxeꞌ tukꞌ vibꞌaaleꞌ.
As la teqꞌo veꞌt tibꞌ naj tukꞌ u tixqeleꞌ.
As umaꞌl kuxh veꞌt itxumbꞌal naj tukꞌ u tixqeleꞌ la ibꞌaneꞌ, tiꞌk u yoleꞌ.

content: As nim talcheꞌ u yoleꞌ. Pet aꞌ u qatineꞌ ni taleꞌ tukꞌ u Cristo, oꞌ uvaꞌ oꞌ niman tetz Aak.
Estiꞌeꞌ ni val sete, ex tzumela, xoꞌnoj vetixqeleꞌ sete echeꞌ uveꞌ nebꞌan jeꞌ sete. As echat ex, ex ixqela, la enima vetzumeleꞌ.
